summary.content:
Today's selection covers 97 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI giant Anthropic woos potential investors ahead of stock market debut
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: F-Secure Launches Victim-First Scam Encyclopedia Covering 50+ Types of Consumer Fraud
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
